about.story: Tazza Produce began as a small neighborhood grocery and grew into a Bay Ridge staple. Three decades later, it is still run by the same family.
about.story.head: From one shelf to a 24-hour market
about.story.body1: What started with a few crates of produce became a full Middle Eastern and halal grocery. We kept the things that matter: fresh stock every day, halal meats you can trace, and a counter where we know our regulars by name.
about.story.body2: Being open 24 hours means the early cook, the night-shift worker, and the parent grabbing pitas at midnight all have a place to shop.
about.card1.title: Daily turnover
about.card1.body: Produce arrives and turns over every day. We would rather sell today's stock than yesterday's.
about.card2.title: Sourced with care
about.card2.body: Our halal meats come from named certifiers, with supplier certificates kept on file and available on request.
about.card3.title: A neighborhood staple
about.card3.body: We live here. The same family that stocks the shelves greets you at the counter.

legal.sub: The documents that govern orders, your data, and how we operate.
legal.disclaimer: This is a design mockup. Final policies should be reviewed by a New York-licensed attorney before launch.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.body:
These terms govern your use of the Tazza Produce website and any online orders you place. By placing an order you agree to pay the listed price, including any applicable taxes, and to collect your order from 302 86th St, Brooklyn, NY 11209 during open hours. Online orders are prepared for pickup; product availability may change without notice based on daily stock, and prices shown online are estimates with the in-store total at pickup final. The store may refuse, substitute, or cancel any order, including for mispricing, unavailable items, or suspected fraud. No-shows not collected within 24 hours of the agreed pickup window may be cancelled and refunded less a restocking fee at our discretion.

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York, and any dispute shall be resolved exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Kings County, New York. Tazza Produce is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, and our total liability for any order is limited to the amount paid. Contact us at +1 718-333-5019 for any dispute resolution.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.body:
We collect only the information needed to fulfill your order: name, contact details, and order contents. We do not collect or store any payment card details online; payment is collected in store on pickup.

Contact form submissions are used to reply to your message and are not shared with third parties except as required to process an order or as required by law. We do not sell your data. You may request deletion of your submitted information by emailing our contact address.
legal.refund.title: Refund Policy
legal.refund.body:
If an item is incorrect or not to standard, contact us within 24 hours of pickup at +1 718-333-5019 for a replacement or refund. Perishable goods (meat, produce, dairy) are assessed on a case-by-case basis. Refunds are handled in store at the time of pickup where applicable.

Orders cancelled before preparation are refunded in full. We reserve the right to deny refunds where policy abuse is suspected.
legal.accessibility.title: Accessibility
legal.accessibility.body: We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. The site supports keyboard navigation, visible focus states, sufficient color contrast, and respects reduced-motion preferences. The store is accessible at street level. Feedback on accessibility is welcome at hello@tazzaproduce.example.
